rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=5, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=400, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-7 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = train_n 200 -> 400 (DATA COVERAGE), the campaign-confirmed lever for end-to-end trainers (uswin +0.0297, itnet_v3 +0.0165). BASE_ITER=4 (BEST SSIM 0.898033, hr0: lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=7e-4 cosine, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). epochs traded 10 -> 5 PURELY to hold GRAD-STEP PARITY with iter-4 (ep10*tn200 = ep5*tn400 = 2000 steps) AND the HARD 1200s wall. This is the clean data-coverage test iter-5 was NOT: iter-5 raised tn 200->300 but cut ep 10->7 -> 2100 steps (broke parity) yet STILL produced the LOWEST RMSE on the whole arc (1.139e-3 vs iter-4 1.416e-3) -> more data drove RMSE DOWN even under-trained, so the data lever was NOT cleanly falsified (the prior iter-6 mis-read iter-5 as falsifying it). At grad-step parity vs iter-4, ANY SSIM/RMSE move is attributable to DATA COVERAGE alone, isolating it from extra optimization. WHY DATA IS NOT INERT: LPD loads a FIXED train_n subset ONCE (build_dataset->load_val_split) then torch.randperm reshuffles that SAME tensor each epoch (no RotatingSubsetDataset), so tn200 only ever showed the net 200/579 distinct slices (35%); tn400 = 69% of the 579-slice patient-balanced pool (groups 154/98/327; group-2 caps 98), adding ~200 genuinely-new slices spanning all 3 train patients -> the campaign DATA-COVERAGE lever, the strongest untried-clean axis. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s: total ~ fixed_overhead + per_step*(epochs*train_n), batch=1. iter-4 = ep10*tn200 = 2000 steps ran 1100.7s = 18.35min. iter-7 = ep5*tn400 = 2000 steps -> COMPUTE-IDENTICAL grad-step count -> ~1100s = 18.3min, +100s margin under the 1200s wall (ep6*tn400 = 2400 steps would be ~1325s, OVER -> ep5 is the budget-fit epoch count for tn400). lpd_hidden^/lpd_iters^ stay OFF (add per-sample projector fwd+adj cost, blow the wall; iter-6 deeper-unroll fell to 0.831). HYP: 69%-vs-35% patient-balanced data coverage at matched optimization lets LPD generalise to held-out L277 better, lifting SSIM toward/above iter-4 0.898 AND pushing RMSE below iter-5 1.139e-3 toward clearing the LD-FBP floor (hr>0 for the first time on LPD Mayo); predict SSIM ~0.90-0.92, hr 0 -> possibly slightly >0. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: SSIM <= 0.898 (iter-4) AND RMSE >= 1.139e-3 (iter-5) with hr still 0.000 => data coverage is NOT the lever even at grad-step parity; LPD is FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete at 2304>>Nyquist, no ill-posedness headroom for the unrolled updates), the SAME mechanism that makes it the 128-view-SPARSE breast/demo CHAMPION yet hr0 on dense Mayo -> documented structural ceiling toward iter-20. ep5 under-train confound bounded: if SSIM DROPS below iter-2 0.864 (ep10/tn200) the epoch cut dominated and tn400 needs a deeper wall, not this budget.
